Человеческий глаз устроен сложнее, чем с: The human eye is more complex than the most modern camera. However, the eye and the camera share a common fundamental optical scheme. There is a converging lens (camera lens and eye lens) and a screen (camera photosensitive sensor and retina). The camera produces sharp images of objects at different distances by changing the distance between the lens and the screen; the eye does so by changing the focal length of the lens.
